items.period: Shuowen seal-script style; modern redraw uploaded 2016-07-08, not an independently dated artifact
items.tradition: Chinese seal-script style, identified by Commons as Shuowen seal script
items.caption: Modern redraw of 休 in Shuowen seal-script style. It illustrates a later script form; the character’s original graph interpretation remains disputed.
items.alt: A modern vector drawing of the character 休 in a seal-script style.
items.selection_reason: The Commons description page identifies the exact character and script style, provides the original SVG link, and states public-domain reuse terms. This offers a sourced later-form example while making clear that it is a modern redraw and cannot settle the disputed original analysis.
items.rights: Public domain; Commons says attribution is not required but appreciated.
